items.question: How long is a patent valid in the UAE under the industrial property law?
items.gold: A patent is valid for 20 years from the date of application or from the date of international filing.
items.fact: Patent validity is 20 years from application date

items.question: How long is a utility model certificate valid in the UAE?
items.gold: A utility certificate is valid for 10 years from the date of application or from the date of international filing.
items.fact: Utility model certificate validity is 10 years from application
